name: unsafe fn from_raw_fd (fd : RawFd , metadata : Self :: Metadata) -> Self
rule: The `fd` passed to `from_raw_fd` must be an owned file descriptor; in particular, it must be open.
api: trait FromRawFd  : { unsafe fn from_raw_fd (fd : std::os::fortanix_sgx::io::RawFd , metadata : Self::Metadata) -> Self }
